review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked its definitions against Mathlib: schwarzChristoffelDensity, schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand and schwarzChristoffelEdgeAngle. Each is specific to Schwarz–Christoffel maps and reuses existing notions (Real.rpow, Complex.cpow, Finset.prod, Complex.exp). None is a competing version of a Mathlib concept. The file does not define its own half-plane or interval notions. `upperHalfPlaneSet` comes from Primitive.lean, which is outside this file and which I only grepped. Several of the theorems restate their definitions or are small identities, but that falls under standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I found no justified finding.
